description: Ministry of Investment promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. "COLOMBO MARINA DEVELOPMENT (PRIVATE) LIMITED.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It contains a formal order specifying regulatory designations, exemptions, and incentives for a business entity, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities (only his title "Minister of Investment Promotion" is mentioned), and the core content is regulatory in nature rather than focused on government personnel or structural changes.
